steps.title: Cut and remove the outer film and tape
steps.description: Cut the outer film with scissors and remove it. Then cut and remove the packing tape around the cardboard box.

steps.title: Open the box and take out the robot
steps.description: Open the front flaps, then move the robot out through the opening with its inner box and foam protection in place.

steps.title: Take out the accessories
steps.description: Take the accessories box out of the recess in the rear foam protection.

steps.title: Remove the rear and side foam
steps.description: Remove the large foam protection surrounding the rear and sides of the robot.

steps.title: Remove the inner packaging
steps.description: Remove the fixing tape, take away the front inner box, then remove the remaining front foam protection.

steps.title: Open the crate and take out the robot
steps.description: Start with the wooden crate upright. Open the front panel, then move the robot out with its inner box and foam protection in place.

steps.title: Take out the accessories
steps.description: Take the accessories box out of the recess in the rear foam protection.
